note: One source of truth for every action Jarvis can perform on the phone. The bridge exposes these to the app as OpenAI tool/function schemas; the app never hard-codes them.

tools.name: battery_status
tools.title: Battery status
tools.description: Read the phone battery level, temperature, health and charging state.

tools.name: network_info
tools.title: Wi-Fi / network info
tools.description: Read the current Wi-Fi connection: SSID, IP address, link speed and signal strength.

tools.name: device_info
tools.title: Device / SIM info
tools.description: Read device and SIM information such as network operator and country.

tools.name: location
tools.title: Location
tools.description: Get the phone's current location (latitude, longitude, accuracy, speed).

args.name: request
args.description: once = fresh fix, last = last known

tools.name: volume_get
tools.title: Read volume
tools.description: Read the current volume of every audio stream (music, call, ring, alarm, notification, system).

tools.name: volume_set
tools.title: Set volume
tools.description: Change the volume of one audio stream, for example the music volume.

tools.name: brightness_set
tools.title: Set screen brightness
tools.description: Set the screen brightness. 0 is darkest, 255 is brightest.

tools.name: torch
tools.title: Flashlight
tools.description: Turn the phone flashlight on or off.

tools.name: vibrate
tools.title: Vibrate
tools.description: Vibrate the phone for a number of milliseconds.

tools.name: get_time
tools.title: Date and time
tools.description: Read the phone's current date, time and timezone.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send a text message (SMS) from this phone to a phone number.

args.name: number
args.description: Recipient phone number in international or local format

tools.name: read_sms
tools.title: Read SMS
tools.description: Read recent text messages from the phone's SMS inbox or sent box.

tools.name: call_number
tools.title: Phone call
tools.description: Place a phone call to a number. This really dials out.

tools.name: contacts_search
tools.title: Contacts
tools.description: List the phone's contacts (name and number) so you can look someone up.

tools.name: notification_list
tools.title: Read notifications
tools.description: Read the notifications currently shown by other apps.

tools.name: notify
tools.title: Show notification
tools.description: Show a notification on the phone from Jarvis.

tools.name: clipboard_get
tools.title: Read clipboard
tools.description: Read whatever text is currently copied on the phone.

tools.name: clipboard_set
tools.title: Copy to clipboard
tools.description: Copy text to the phone clipboard so the user can paste it elsewhere.

tools.name: speak_text
tools.title: Speak out loud
tools.description: Speak text out loud using the phone's text-to-speech engine (works even when the screen is off or the app is closed).

tools.name: toast
tools.title: On-screen toast
tools.description: Show a short pop-up message on screen.

tools.name: camera_photo
tools.title: Take a photo
tools.description: Take a photo with the front or back camera and save it to a file.

args.name: path
args.description: Where to save the photo. Leave empty to save into the phone's Pictures folder with a timestamped name.

tools.name: open_url
tools.title: Open a link
tools.description: Open a web page in the phone's browser.

args.name: url
args.description: URL to open, must start with http:// or https://

tools.name: launch_app
tools.title: Open an app
tools.description: Launch another app on the phone by its package name, for example com.whatsapp or com.google.android.youtube.

args.name: package
args.description: Android package name of the app to open

tools.name: list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List files in a folder on the phone. Only inside the home folder or shared storage.

tools.name: read_file
tools.title: Read a file
tools.description: Read a text file from the phone (notes, CSV, logs). Only inside the home folder or shared storage.

tools.name: note_save
tools.title: Remember something
tools.description: Save a long-term note or memory on the phone so it can be recalled later, for example a preference or an important fact.

args.name: text
args.description: The fact or note to remember

tools.name: note_list
tools.title: Recall memories
tools.description: List everything Jarvis has been told to remember.

tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run a shell command
tools.description: Run any Termux shell command on the phone. Use this for anything the other tools cannot do, for example copying files, using ffmpeg, or scripting.

args.name: command
args.description: The shell command to run, for example: ls ~/storage/shared | head
